card.name: Contrast words before a worse or better outcome
card.fires_on: Words that set up a contrast or a good-versus-bad outcome, such as while, despite, but, less than, did not and out-compete. It fires where the next words could describe something getting worse or being held off.

modes.label: Contrast linkers
modes.description: Small words like while, despite, or but that introduce a contrasting clause.
modes.example: Such competition would allow schools that provide a quality education to flourish<< while>> punishing schools that provide a poor education.

modes.label: Reduction or prevention words
modes.description: Words about being less than, resisting, deterring, or not returning.
modes.example: Xavier informs us in a very simple way that Rodriguez was so overjoyed to see him that the fever did<< not>> return.

modes.label: Dose-reduction wording
modes.description: The words less than in a dose or lab-value limit.
modes.example: absolute decrease to less<< than>> or equal to 10% compared

card.plain: It marks words that set up a contrast or a held-off problem, where text might next say something got worse.
